detail: Full summary: EventStore.rebuild() re-journals every event with ingress hard-coded to 'import' (src/events/event-store.ts step 1 of rebuild), losing the originating ingress. Today ingress only feeds the journal reason string, so nothing depends on it — but any future rule keyed on ingress will silently differ between first admission and rebuild. The journal has no ingress column.
